name.zh: 天童预告冰灾红莲地狱
name.en: Tendo announces the freezing disaster Red Lotus Hell

periods.location: Toka's hospital room in Miyazaki; Fukuoka disaster zone
periods.summary: Tendo manifests in Toka's hospital room, terrifying her and explaining that the death-chain she sees is the limit of her fate. He announces that later that day he will use the ice disaster Red Lotus Hell to freeze the seas around Kyushu, trapping all evacuees in a lethal blizzard for three days. He leaves his twig cross necklace and tells Toka to overcome fear, hate him, and kill him. Soon afterward, temperatures begin falling and the emergency center confirms abnormal weather in Fukuoka.
periods.cause: Tendo wants to force Toka back into his trial after Kurono's recall removes the planned professional counterattack.
periods.process: Tendo touches Toka, forces her to look at him, and describes how even Wakaba House's children will freeze unless she personally defeats him. He speaks lovingly rather than maliciously, again revealing his distorted belief that terror is divine mercy.
periods.outcome: Toka tries to use the cross as a focus to confront her death vision and force an Awakening, but repeated mental deaths break her. Tendo's freezing storm begins expanding across Kyushu.
periods.significance: Escalates Kyushu from evacuation problem to immediate deadline and pushes Toka into the crisis that makes Nishikata's intervention necessary.
